column1: # Groups of parts that run as one unit under tests/run -j N (contract D5).
# A line is a group's name, a tab, and a part's file name; empty lines and lines
# starting # are ignored. A group's lines are adjacent, its members follow one
# another in the driver's order with no part between, it has two to six, a part
# is in at most one, and none of 0001 to 0009 or 9990 is in any. tests/run -j 1
# ib: 0940 reads the $IB/runs/*.err files that 0900 to 0930 write (97 files in
# order, 28 alone), so under -j N they run in one process, in order.
# rx: 1100 builds the reach fixture (tests/lib/reach.sh), 1110 takes it up and 1120 takes it up and removes
# its base, so under -j N they run in one process, in order. Where $TMP's ancestors are writable by others
# the base is a directory outside $TMP that the fixture guard's roots gain, and 1120 puts them back.
# gp: 0201's check that no refusal its block provoked reached the suite's refusal record (0201:308-311) reads
# from _gp_rec0, which lib/gitproof.sh sets once, at 0200's first call, so serially it judges the refusals 0200
# and 0201 provoked and alone only 0201's. Under -j N they run in one process, in order (25 s serially).
# au: 0850's check that nothing changed outside the review fixtures and that no claude, gh, curl or wget was
# called (0850:182-197) reads the stub log and the snapshots taken before 0810's first audit run, so serially it
# judges the audit runs of 0810 to 0850 and alone only 0850's. Under -j N they run in one process, in order
